sources.title: Anthropic Claude Duet proactive agent (Oct 21)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Research preview by waitlist, US Pro and Max subscribers first, sharing existing plan usage limits; background checks consume plan limits and larger tasks cost more turns.
Proactive agent on Opus 5.5: morning brief, monitors connected apps, completes scheduling/dashboard/forecast/web-app tasks, keeps working when away, checks before key actions.

Runs in VM with own browser; 6000+ Marketplace connectors (Gmail/Slack, QuickBooks/Stripe, Gusto, LinkedIn, Docusign, HubSpot, Canva, Shopify); Stripe Link virtual card and Shop Pay; 1Password sign-in coming soon; securities trading and money movement off-limits even with approval.

Safety stack: trustworthy-agents framework, Managed-Agents credential design (never sees passwords/tokens), auto-mode classifier approval, browser-use prompt-injection defenses, red-team plus external pen-test plus bug bounty, dedicated CC/gov-ID blocking classifier.
Work-first limits: personal errands weaker, cannot show its browser yet; standalone app separate from main Claude app.
